item.title: PG&E Poe Dam Fall Releases Enable Whitewater Runs on North Fork Feather River
item.description:
PG&E Poe Dam Fall Releases Enable Whitewater Runs on North Fork Feather River

During the federal hydropower relicensing process, American Whitewater negotiated annual fall releases from PG&E’s Poe Dam to provide whitewater recreation opportunities on the North Fork Feather River’s Poe Reach.

🔍 Overview

  • The Poe Run is the lowermost run on the North Fork Feather.
  • The reach is seven miles long and consists of two distinct sections: Poe Canyon and Bardees Bar.

📅 Schedule

  • In 2026, releases are scheduled for October 10‑11 and October 24‑25.

🏞️ River Sections

Section Difficulty (Class)
Poe Canyon IV/V
Bardees Bar III/IV

🚗 Access

  • An access road at the midpoint of Bardees Bar allows boaters to:
    • Run only the Class IV/V (Poe Canyon) segment,
    • Run only the lower Class III/IV (Bardees Bar) segment,
    • Or run both segments in a single trip.

🎥 Learn More

  • Watch American Whitewater’s video on the Bardees Bar section: CURRENT RELEASE | Feather River: Bardee’s Bar.
